body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Kodak unveiled its newest Kodak Easyshare digital camera 'M575' at CES 2010.

Kodak Easyshare digital M575 Digital Camera features 14MP, 5X SCHNEIDER-KREUZNACH VARIOGON Optical Zoom Wide Angle Lens, 3-inch bright LCD with KODAK Color Science technology, HD video capture, and more. The M575 will be available in red, green, blue, black and brown for US $179.95 MSRP beginning in April 2010.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
